Geometric M, liquid objects

The liquid M

The Nautilus M sways, lingers at each side, and every so often pours itself into one of your interests, then flows back. Same object library as the moving M, now with the liquid motion.

SwayRight and left, never quite stopping, a slow wobble in the drop and feet.
PourThe shape fills from the top down, like liquid, with a small tilt.
LandDetails arrive a beat after the shape and leave just before it moves.

The object library, liquid

Every object pours out of the same M and back into it, each on its own interest color and its own timing.
